cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Outfeel the Room
cards.instruction: Answer every fear, sacrifice, or disappointment with one of your own that deserves more attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Your opening had empty seats? Mine had two people, and both left.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry. Have my complimentary drink.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Thank you. My theatre couldn't even afford to console us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you listen now? My dad left before my scene.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mine asked for a refund. Could you stay while I finish this? I haven't told anyone that.
